summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py; nothing was committed and no tests, mypy, or black runs were performed (per instructions). Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed keyword (default False), a static render_speed(speed) method that formats via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix with base 1000 and "it/s", and a render path that uses finished_speed or speed when the total is unknown and show_speed is on. Module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) passed to the column. Progress.track now infers an Optional total (sequence length or None) instead of raising for non-Sized iterables. Added a CHANGELOG line and test_task_progress_column_speed; removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Unverified: the test suite, mypy strict, and black have not been run.
